title: Prepare initial molecular geometries
action: Generate initial Cartesian coordinates for SiH4, SiF4, Si(OH)4, SiO4^4-, and Si2O7^6- using standard experimental bond lengths and symmetries (Td for SiH4, SiF4, SiO4^4-; S4 for Si(OH)4; D3d for Si2O7^6-).
description: Create MOPAC input files with the initial structures and appropriate keywords (MNDO, geometry optimization, force, IR intensities).

title: Run MNDO geometry optimization and vibrational analysis
action: For each of the five molecules, execute MOPAC with the MNDO method to perform geometry optimization and vibrational analysis (computation of force constants, vibrational frequencies, and IR transition dipoles).
description: This step executes the core computation. The MOPAC output files contain optimized coordinates, force constants, frequencies, normal modes, and IR transition dipoles.

title: Extract optimized bond lengths and angles
action: Parse the MOPAC output files to obtain the optimized bond lengths and angles for each molecule. Write the results to optimized_geometries.csv.
description: Scored artifact containing the optimized geometric parameters. The checker compares these bond lengths to the paper's reported values within tolerance.
output_schema: molecule:string, bond_type:string, length_Angstrom:float, angle_deg:float (optional; one row per unique bond/angle)

title: Extract IR-active frequencies and relative intensities
action: Parse the MOPAC frequency output to list all vibrational modes with non-zero IR intensity. For each molecule, report the IR-active frequencies and their relative intensities in ir_active_frequencies.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the IR line spectrum data for each small molecule. The checker verifies the symmetry pattern: exactly two IR-active modes for Td molecules, and correct degeneracy for Si2O7^6- (consistent with D3d symmetry).
output_schema: array of objects with molecule:string, frequency_cm-1:float, relative_intensity:float
